description: Order requests and tanks (R4, R7): web_portal intake adapter and pipeline changes (ingest_portal, deterministic portal order id, existing-id guard, step i3 hold stamp), FuelOrderRepository filters + transition_if CAS, the extracted fuel/services/order_actions.cancel_order, staff release-hold CAS and hold_reason list filter, scoped order/tank/forecast readers, PortalOrderService with the 409 ORDER_INTAKE_DISABLED handling and replay rules, the portal order and tank endpoints, and their tests (incl. OID-1..3 and the order/tank parts of the isolation matrix). Design §2.4 (order/tank/forecast rows), §4, §7, F3, F6, D4, D5, D9, DV10. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: 1. fuel/order_models.py: PORTAL_REVIEW_HOLD_REASON = 'awaiting_dispatcher_confirmation' next to LOADABLE_ORDER_STATUSES. fuel/order_repository.py FuelOrderRepository.search gains customer_tank_id, statuses (terms / in_filters) and hold_reason filters on both the ES and Postgres read_hybrid_search paths; add transition_if(tenant_id, order_id, *, expected_status, expected_hold_reason=_ANY, update_fields) -> Optional[dict] on atomic_update; caller mirrors with mirror_current_state_upsert like _apply_order_update.

2. fuel/services/order_actions.py: extract the inline cancel + order_cancelled event + driver counter decrement from fuel/api/order_endpoints.py cancel_order into cancel_order(repo, tenant_id, order_id, *, actor_user_id, reason, notes, expected_status, expected_hold_reason=_ANY, counter_service) using transition_if; the staff endpoint calls it with expected_status=order.status and keeps its response unchanged. release_hold_order's final 'placed' write becomes transition_if(expected_status='on_hold', expected_hold_reason=order.hold_reason) and returns 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION on None; hook re-run and event shape unchanged. Staff GET /api/orders gains optional hold_reason query param passed to search. Re-read the post-rebase order_endpoints.py first: OI-41 added transition_order_guarded for the status route; do not alter that path.

3. fuel/intake/web_portal_adapter.py WebPortalIntakeAdapter (shape of DispatcherIntakeAdapter; required fields per §4.2; stamps intake_channel/web_portal, intake_metadata {portal_session_id: None}; one order_placed event {intake_channel, intake_channel_id, actor_user_id}); register in bootstrap/fuel.py next to the dispatcher adapter (~line 124). fuel/services/order_intake_pipeline.py: portal_event_id(), portal_order_id(), _PortalChannel (like _CsvImportChannel), ingest_portal(), web_portal branch in _complete_order_doc, existing-id guard right after _complete_order_doc (FuelOrderRepository.get; hit -> mark_processed + IntakeResponse(status='duplicate'); repo error propagates), hold stamp step i3 after the before_accept loop and before FuelOrder.model_validate (only when status == 'placed').

4. portal/services/scoped_readers.py: PortalOrderReader (list keyset by created_at desc with base64url cursor, get, get_or_none), PortalTankReader (list active, get with customer + active check), PortalForecastReader.latest_by_tank (mvp_tank_forecasts, term tenant_id + customer_id, sort timestamp desc, size 500, first per tank). Every method takes scope: PortalScope first, passes both ids into the store query, asserts non-empty customer_id, and raises the same resource_not_found(...) as the miss case for out-of-scope ids. portal/services/projection.py: ORDER_STATUS_MAP covering every OrderStatus literal, tank label, PortalOrder/PortalTank projections. portal/models.py: PortalOrderRequest (extra='forbid', discriminated quantity union, window rules F6, po_number, notes), PortalOrder, PortalTank, delivery item models.

5. portal/services/portal_order_service.py PortalOrderService.submit per design §4.1 steps 1-7 including the disabled-state replay read, tank 404, capacity 422 (field quantity.gallons), ship-to rule D4, step 6a replay pre-check, pipeline result mapping table (legacy_passthrough -> 409 ORDER_INTAKE_DISABLED; processed -> 201 + Location; duplicate -> 200 original or 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; queued_for_review -> 422 ORDER_REQUEST_REJECTED ERROR log; ORDER_PAYLOAD_INVALID -> 422 passthrough; INVALID_CUSTOMER_TANK_REF -> 404; other AppException/PricingError/DyedDieselOrderRejected -> 422 ORDER_REQUEST_REJECTED fixed message, WARN with class name only). cancel per §4.4 via order_actions.cancel_order with expected on_hold + portal reason -> 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE.

6. portal/api/order_endpoints.py (GET list, GET detail, POST create with order limit, POST cancel with cancel limit) and portal/api/tank_endpoints.py (GET /tanks with one next-delivery query size 200 sorted delivery_window_start:asc, GET /tanks/{id}, GET /tanks/{id}/deliveries 730-day window keyset <=50). All handlers take request: Request and scope=Depends(require_portal_customer); routers carry Depends(reject_scope_params); path ids validated by the §3.2 regex with malformed -> 404. Mount in main.py / portal router tuple. Wire PortalOrderService in bootstrap (fuel or core) with the pipeline and repositories.

7. Tests (Runsheet-backend/tests/portal/): test_portal_orders.py (OID-1 incl. replay-while-disabled, OID-2, OID-3 for shadow/active_gated/active_auto, ORD-1, ORD-1b, ORD-2 parametrized PD9 + F6 boundaries -24h±1s/+60d±1s, ORD-5, ORD-6 with stub before_accept hooks raising AppException/PricingError/DyedDieselOrderRejected), test_portal_loadable_exclusion.py (ORD-3 / T-ORD-LOADABLE against route_planning_agent, delivery_prioritization_agent, compartment_loading_agent candidate queries), test_order_release_hold_portal.py (ORD-4 a, a2, b, c, d), test_projection.py::test_order_status_map_total (ORD-7), test_portal_tanks.py (TNK-1), and add order/tank cases to test_portal_isolation.py (ISO-C-1, ISO-C-2, ISO-T-1 for order, order cancel, tank, tank history, next delivery) and test_scoped_readers.py (ISO-C-3 spies for FuelOrderRepository.search, CustomerTankRepository.list_for_tenant, forecast search). Add test_portal_scope_import_lint.py (ISO-C-5 AST scan of portal/api/). ISO-C-6 restricted-field cases for orders. Existing tests for the staff cancel/release-hold routes must pass unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: With overlay state disabled, POST /api/portal/orders returns 409 ORDER_INTAKE_DISABLED with no repository write and /me shows ordering_available=false; a replay of an existing client_event_id returns 200 with the original order_id (OID-1, OID-2 pass)

In shadow/active_gated/active_auto a valid request is stored on_hold / awaiting_dispatcher_confirmation on web_portal with product and lat/lon from the tank (OID-3 passes) and is absent from planner/loader/prioritizer candidate queries until release-hold (ORD-3 passes)
release-hold moves a portal order to placed without re-holding; a hook-set hold is never overwritten; confirm-vs-cancel race gives 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION (ORD-4 passes)

Customer A gets 404 with a body identical to an unknown id for customer B's and tenant T2's orders, order cancel, tanks and tank history; lists contain only A's rows (order/tank parts of ISO-C-1, ISO-C-2, ISO-T-1 pass)
Existing staff order endpoint tests pass unchanged
